description: Unread comments and handoffs are signalled only inside an opened task panel. Board cards carry no unread or mention badge, so catching up means opening every task.
expected: Cards show an unread count (e.g. '3 new') or a dot; ideally a 'For you' filter.
actual: The card shows title, priority and assignee only.
suggested_fix: Compute per-task unread counts for the viewer (as the panel does) and render a badge on the board card.

description: Mark all read sends receipts for the reader's own comments too, so Activity reads 'Priya Raman read 5 comments' when only 3 were unread.
expected: Receipts only for unread revisions; 'read 3 comments'.
suggested_fix: Filter Mark all read to comments with unread revisions (exclude own).

description: The panel lists comments oldest-first below GitHub issues, Status and older comments, so new comments are off-screen with no jump link. The open panel also covers the Review column and clips the selected card.
expected: The '3 new' suffix is a link that scrolls to the first new comment; the selected card stays visible.
actual: Manual scrolling; the card is clipped under the panel.
suggested_fix: Make the new-count a button that scrolls to the first .is-new article; let the board scroll the selected card into view.
